sources.title: GPU Networking: InfiniBand vs RoCE vs Proprietary
sources.snippet: The choice of interconnect technology directly determines training efficiency, with InfiniBand NDR400 delivering 400 Gbps per port versus RoCE v2 at 200-400 Gbps and NVLink reaching 900 GB/s within an HGX baseboard. NVIDIA NVLink/NVSwitch dominates intra-node communication with 900 GB/s bidirectional bandwidth across 8 H100 GPUs.
